peak_pose: standing facing the viewer, chest forward and back arched, one shoulder rolled forward and raised, both hands resting low on her hips, head tilted toward the raised shoulder
expression: playful half-lidded eyes on the viewer, slow smirk
motion: She does two slow, rolling shoulder shimmies, left then right, each roll travelling through her chest with a soft, delayed jiggle and settle; her pigtails swing lazily with the rhythm and her tail curls; unhurried, smooth, confident, returning exactly to the start pose.
name: shoulder_roll_shimmy
